page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a catchword "Ad" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rium, Nyssenum, Theodore-tum, Prosperum, Fulgentium, Remigium: ut taceam Bernardum, Bedam, Anselmum, quos auctarii vice adjecimus: (quorum omnium Testimonia oculatâ fide allegavimus, non solùm meâ, sed & aliorum.) De quibus verè pronunciare possum, eos in hac controversia nostra contra Meritum de Condigno, tam nostros esse, quàm erat (cujus etiam ibidem meminit Campianus) Pontifex Gregorius Latinus totus noster. Gregorius, inquam, qui, non modò alios erudiens, statuit vitam æternam non Propter, sed Secundum opera redi: verumetiam, ut sibi conscius,

page.notes: The page number at the top right is hard to read; it is given as "VI" with [?]. The running head is "EPISTOLA". The faint marks at the lower left are show-through and were left out. The first line "rium" is a fragment and is kept as a fragment. "Theodore-tum" is written with its printed hyphen across the line break.
